rca_of_the_issue: Root cause (auth cluster): OTPLoginPage's legacy password path wrote localStorage.salon_user_auth={accessToken:...} while EnhancedSalonDashboard.getAuthHeaders read authData.token → 'Authorization: Bearer undefined' → 401 across attendance/shop/inventory/orders/customers. Fix: write field name `token` in OTPLoginPage (line 163) + tolerate both keys in getAuthHeaders (line 445). Secondary root cause (permission 403 potential): check_permission only bypassed for salon_admin, missing legacy `salon` and `admin`. Fix: extended bypass to all four admin/manager roles.
